column1: # Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The guest block keeps the provisional heap. An iPhone needs the allocator cut for the build and a capped region (game_args), as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/agents/03)
# the NPDM declares 100 MB of system resource
# The game steps by the time that really passed: the opening story and the field ran at the same speed at 30 and 60 fps (DM_FPS_PIN, Odin 2). Its frames
# take 24-35 ms of work in the story and the field on the Odin 2, so 60 is out of reach: fps_ceiling 30 holds it at 30 and porter's --fps60 lifts it (DM_FPS_CEILING=0)
# the engine reads its GPU frame times from NVN timestamps, which count at 614.4 MHz on the Switch
